  In addition to providing public comment in person at the meeting, the following
  opportunity has been established:

  Public Comments

  Please email all public comments on items on this agenda to cityclerk@sgch.org and
  include the following on the subject line of your email: PUBLIC COMMENT:
  12/20/2022 Regular Meeting. The Clerk will read public comments into the record
  for up to the three-minute limit. Words that would disrupt the meeting, including
  profanity, obscenity, and discriminatory language, will not be read. All public
  comments shall be e-mailed by 5:00 P.M. on meeting day.

City Council Regular Meeting Agenda – December 20, 2022
  1
   City Council Regular Meeting Agenda
  Tuesday, December 20, 2022

 •  CALL TO ORDER
 •  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE LED BY: Council Member Wu
 •  ROLL CALL: Mayor Ding, Vice Mayor Harrington, Council Members Menchaca,
  Rivera, Wu

 1. APPROVAL OF AGENDA ORDER

 2. PRESENTATIONS

  A. RECOGNITION OF OUTGOING POLICE CHIEF EUGENE HARRIS

  B. STUNTS AND FUN EVENT DONATION

 3. PUBLIC COMMENT

 4. CONSENT CALENDAR

  All items listed under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and
  recommendations will be approved in one motion unless a member of the
  City Council or audience requests separate discussion.

  A. RESOLUTION NO. 22-75 REAUTHORIZING THE CITY COUNCIL AND THE
  CITY’S COMMISSIONS TO IMPLEMENT TELECONFERENCE ACCESSIBILITY
  FOR CONDUCTING PUBLIC MEETINGS PURSUANT TO ASSEMBLY BILL 361

  Resolution No. 22-75 makes findings that allow the City to continue
  implementation of teleconference/internet-based accessibility for public
  meetings under state-of-emergency provisions. There is no fiscal impact related
  to this item.

  CEQA Determination: Not a Project as defined in Section 15378 of the State CEQA
  Guidelines.

  Recommended Action:

  Staff recommends that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 22-75 regarding
  the use of teleconferencing for public meetings.

City Council Regular Meeting Agenda – December 20, 2022  2
   B. APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  The minutes are a record of the official actions taken at the City Council
  meeting.

  1. Minutes of the City Council Special Meeting of December 6, 2022.

  CEQA Determination: Not a Project as defined in Section 15378 of the State CEQA
  Guidelines.

  Recommended Action: Approval

  C. MATERIAL DEMANDS

  The most recent Material Demands from the Finance Department are presented
  to the City Council for review and approval.

  CEQA Determination: Not a Project as defined in Section 15378 of the State CEQA
  Guidelines.

  Recommended Action:

  Staff recommends that the City Council approve Material Demands as
  presented.

  D. CASH AND INVESTMENT REPORT – NOVEMBER 2022

  In accordance with the City of San Gabriel’s 2022-2023 Adopted Investment
  Policy (Resolution No. 22-30) and California Government Code Section 53646,
  the Finance Director is to render an investment report to the City Council, City
  Treasurer, City Manager, and the City Attorney. The November 2022 Cash and
  Investment Report is presented to receive and file in accordance with the City’s
  adopted 2022-23 Investment Policy. There is no fiscal impact related to this
  item.

  CEQA Determination: Not a Project as defined in Section 15378 of the State CEQA
  Guidelines.

  Recommended Action:

  Staff recommends that the City Council receive and file the Cash and
  Investment Report for November 2022.

City Council Regular Meeting Agenda – December 20, 2022  3
   E. MONTHLY BUDGET UPDATE – NOVEMBER 2022

  This report provides the monthly budget update for the City’s General Fund
  and Mission Playhouse as of November 30, 2022. The monthly budget update
  incorporates the actual revenue received and expenditures that have occurred
  through November 30, 2022, and the projects the financial results for the year
  ending June 30, 2023. There is no fiscal impact related to this item.

  CEQA Determination: Not a Project as defined in Section 15378 of the State CEQA
  Guidelines.

  Recommended Action:

  Staff recommends that that City Council received and file report.

  F. RESOLUTION NO. 22-60 – AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2022-23 BUDGET
  TO ACCEPT DONATION FROM SAN GABRIEL COMMUNITY FOUNDATION

  The San Gabriel Community Foundation generously donated funds to support
  the City and Human, Equity, Access, and Relations (HEAR) Commission’s Mental
  Wellness Expo that was held in September. This report is to accept and
  acknowledge the donation and to request that the City Council approve
  Resolution No. 22-60 amending the Fiscal Year 2022-23 Budget to reflect this
  donation. Resolution No. 22-60, amends the Fiscal Year 2022-23 budget to
  reflect the donation for the Mental Wellness Expo.

  CEQA Determination: Not a Project as defined in Section 15378 of the State CEQA
  Guidelines.

  Recommended Action:

  Staff recommends the City Council accept a donation of $2,000.00 from San
  Gabriel Community Foundation and approve Resolution No. 22-60 amending
  the Fiscal Year 2022-23 budget to reflect the donation to the City’s account.

 5. PUBLIC HEARING – None.

 6. CONTINUED BUSINESS – None.

 7. NEW BUSINESS

City Council Regular Meeting Agenda – December 20, 2022  4
   A. RESOLUTION NO. 22-76 DECLARING THE RESULTS AND RECITING THE
  FACT OF THE SAN GABRIEL GENERAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION HELD
  NOVEMBER 8, 2022

  On November 8, 2022, a General Municipal election was held for the purpose of
  electing three members of the City Council, a City Clerk, and a City Treasurer.
  This item is to declare the results: The election of John Wu, Denise Menchaca,
  and Eric Chan as members of the City Council, Thu “Julie” Nguyen as City Clerk,
  and Kevin B. Sawkins as City Treasurer, for four-year terms.

  CEQA Determination: Not a Project as defined in Section 15378 of the State CEQA
  Guidelines.

  Recommended Action:

  Staff recommends that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 22-76 reciting the
  fact of the General Municipal Election held on November 8, 2022, declaring the
  result and such other matters as provided by law.

  B. RECOGNITION OF OUTGOING COUNCIL MEMBER CARINA RIVERA

  C. PRESENTATION OF CERTIFICATES OF ELECTION AND ADMINISTRATION
  OF OATH OF OFFICE

  i. John Wu – Member of the City Council

  ii. Denise Menchaca – Member of the City Council

  iii. Eric Chan – Member of the City Council
  iv. Thu “Julie” Nguyen – City Clerk

  v. Kevin B. Sawkins – City Treasurer

  D. CITY COUNCIL REORGANIZATION

  i. SELECTION OF MAYOR
  ii. SELECTION OF VICE MAYOR

 8. PUBLIC COMMENT

 9. CITY MANAGER’S REPORT

 10. COUNCIL COMMENTS AND CONFERENCE/MEETING REPORTS

City Council Regular Meeting Agenda – December 20, 2022  5
   Each Council Member may address the City Council and public on matters of
  general information and/or concern. This is also the time for Council Members to
  report on conferences and/or meetings they have attended.

  11. CLOSED SESSION – None.

  12. ADJOURNMENT

  The regular meeting scheduled for January 3, 2023 at 6:30 p.m. has been cancelled.
  The next regular City Council meeting will be held on Tuesday, January 17, 2023 at
  6:30 P.M. Information regarding matters to be considered at each meeting will be
  available on the Friday before the City Council Meeting on the City’s website at
  www.sangabrielcity.com.

Materials Available for Inspection. You may view agenda items online at
www.sangabrielcity.com/agendacenter, or in person at City Hall, 425 South Mission Drive,
San Gabriel, CA 91776. Materials related to an item on this Agenda, submitted to the City
Council after distribution of the Agenda packet, will be posted on the City website.
Persons with Disabilities. Upon request, this Agenda will be made available in
appropriate alternative formats to persons with disabilities, as required by Section 202 of
the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990.
Persons requesting a Translator. Any person requesting translation for the meeting
must notify the City Clerk Department at cityclerk@sgch.org at least 48 hours before the
meeting.
Questions about this Agenda? Should any person have a question concerning any of
the above Agenda items prior to the meeting, please contact the City Clerk at
cityclerk@sgch.org during regular office hours.

Any person with a disability who requires a modification or accommodation in order to
participate in a meeting should direct such a request to the City Clerk Department by
emailing cityclerk@sgch.org at least 48 hours before the meeting, if possible.

MINUTES OF DECEMBER 20, 2022
  REGULAR MEETING OF THE SAN GABRIEL CITY COUNCIL

I  CALL TO ORDER

  Mayor Ding called the regular meeting of the San Gabriel City Council to order at 6:35
  P.M. on Tuesday, December 20, 2022, in the Council Chamber at City Hall, 425 South
  Mission Drive, San Gabriel, California, 91776.

  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Council Member Wu.

  ROLL CALL

  Council Members Present:  Denise Menchaca, Carina Rivera, John Wu, Vice Mayor
  John R. Harrington, and Mayor Tony Ding.
  Council Members Absent:  None.
  Staff Members Present:  Police Chief Eugene Harris, City Attorney Keith Lemieux,

I  Community Services Director Rebecca Perez, Chief City
  Clerk Sharon Clark, Public Works Director/City Engineer
  Greg de Vinck, Fire Chief Steven Wallace, Finance
  Director William Kaholokula, Community Development
  Director Aldo Cervantes, and Assistant City Clerk Marilyn
  Bonus.

  ANNOUNCEMENTS

  Chief City Clerk Clark provided information for the public on how to view the meeting and
  how to request meeting agendas.

  1. APPROVAL OF AGENDA ORDER

  Mayor Ding announced that staff had requested that for item 7C, the presentation for City
  Treasurer Sawkins be removed as he was not present at the meeting.

  A motion was made by Council Member Menchaca, seconded by Vice Mayor
  Harrington, to approve the Agenda Order as so amended .

I  Motion carried by a vote of 5-0 as follows:

  AYES:  MENCHACA, RIVERA, WU, HARRINGTON, DING
  NOES:  NONE
  ABSTAIN:  NONE
  ABSENT:  NONE

  2. PRESENTATIONS

  CITY COUNCIL REGULAR MEETING MINUTES  Page 1 of 6  December 20, 2022
   A. RECOGNITION OF OUTGOING POLICE CHIEF EUGENE HARRIS

  Mayor Ding made the presentation.

  The following provided certificates/recognition for Police Chief Harris:

  •  Senior Field Representative/Case Worker Maile Plan from the Office of
  Congresswoman Judy Chu

  •  District Representative Sandra Armenta Lopez for Senator Susan Rubio

I  •
  •
  District Director Jennifer Tang for Assemblymember Mike Fong
  Deputy Director of District Operations Edith Gonzalez, Representing
  Supervisor Hilda Solis

  •  San Gabriel Chamber of Commerce President Joanna Jimenez and
  Immediate Past President Alexis Salamanca
  •  Rosemead Councilmember Sandra Armenta

  Council Members Menchaca, Rivera, Wu, Vice Mayor Harrington, and Mayor Ding
  commended Police Chief Harris for his leadership and accomplishments during his
  time as Police Chief.

  Mayor Ding presented Police Chief Harris with a street name plaque on behalf of
  the City Council and community.

  Police Chief Harris thanked the City Council, community, and Police Department
  members for the work accomplished together.

I  B. STUNTS AND FUN EVENT DONATION

  Economic Development Director Caroline Velarde made the presentation. Sammy
  Maloof, representing Sammy Maloof Racing and the Stuntmen's Association of
  Hollywood, presented the donation to Police Chief Harris and Fire Chief Wallace,
  who accepted on behalf of the City.

  3. PUBLIC COMMENT - None.

  4. CONSENT CALENDAR

  A motion was made by Council Member Menchaca, seconded by Council Member
  Rivera, to approve Consent Calendar Items 4A - 4F as presented.

  Motion carried by a vote of 5-0 as follows:

  AYES:  MENCHACA, RIVERA, WU, HARRINGTON, DING
  NOES:  NONE
  ABSTAIN:  NONE

I  ABSENT:  NONE

  A. RESOLUTION NO. 22-75 REAUTHORIZING THE CITY COUNCIL AND THE
  CITY'S COMMISSIONS TO IMPLEMENT TELECONFERENCE ACCCESSIBILITY
  FOR CONDUCTING PUBLIC MEETINGS PURSUANT TO ASSEMBLY BILL 361

  The City Council adopted Resolution  No. 22-75 regarding the use of
  teleconferencing for public meetings.

  CITY COUNCIL REGULAR MEETING MINUTES  Page 2 of 6  December 20, 2022
   B. APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  The City Council approved the Minutes of the City Council Special Meeting of
  December 6, 2022.

  C. MATERIAL DEMANDS

  The City Council approved October 21 , 2022, and October 28, 2022, Registers of
  Demands and Warrants for the payment of City expenditures.

I  D. CASH AND INVESTMENT REPORT- NOVEMBER 2022

  The City Council received and filed the Cash and Investment Report for November
  2022.

  E. MONTHLY BUDGET UPDATE - NOVEMBER 2022

  The City Council received and filed the report.

  F. RESOLUTION NO. 22-60-AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2022-23 BUDGET TO
  ACCEPT DONATION FROM SAN GABRIEL COMMUNITY FOUNDATION

  The City Council accepted a donation of $2,000.00 from San Gabriel Community
  Foundation and adopted Resolution No. 22-60 amending the Fiscal Year 2022-
  23 budget to reflect the donation to the City's account.

  5. PUBLIC HEARING - None.

I  6. CONTINUED BUSINESS - None.

  7. NEW BUSINESS

  A. RESOLUTION NO. 22-76 DECLARING THE RESULTS AND RECITING THE FACT
  OF THE SAN GABRIEL GENERAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION HELD NOVEMBER 8,
  2022

  Chief City Clerk Clark made the presentation .

  There was no public comment.

  A motion was made by Council Member Menchaca, seconded by Council Member
  Wu, to adopt Resolution No. 22-76 reciting the fact of the General Mun icipal
  Election held on November 8, 2022, declaring the result and such other matters as
  provided by law.

  Motion carried by a vote of 5-0 as follows:

I  AYES:
  NOES:
  MENCHACA, RIVERA, WU, HARRINGTON, DING
  NONE
  ABSTAIN:  NONE
  ABSENT:  NONE

  B. RECOGNITION OF OUTGOING COUNCIL MEMBER CARINA RIVERA

  The following provided certificates of recognition to Council Member Rivera for
  her service to the community:

  CITY COUNCIL REGULAR MEETING MINUTES  Page 3 of 6  December 20, 2022
   •  Senior Field Representative/Case Worker Maile Plan from the Office of
  Congresswoman Judy Chu

  •  District Representative Sandra Armenta Lopez for Senator Susan Rubio
  •  District Director Jennifer Tang for Assemblymember Mike Fong
  •  Deputy Director of District Operations Edith Gonzalez for Supervisor Hilda
  Solis

  •  San Gabriel Chamber of Commerce President Joanna Jimenez, Immediate
  Past President Alexis Salamanca

I  •
  •  Rosemead Council Member Sandra Armenta

  Monterey Park Mayor Henry Lo, Vice Mayor Jose Sanchez, and Council
  Members Vinh Ngo and Yvonne Yiu

  Council Members Menchaca and Wu, Vice Mayor Harrington, and Mayor Ding
  commended Council Member Rivera for her service on the City Council.

  Council Member Rivera thanked the community, staff, those attending the meeting
  to honor her, and her Council colleagues; and commented that she looks forward
  to her new roles as Vice President of the San Gabriel Chamber of Commerce and
  as Small Business Commissioner for Supervisor Solis.

  Mayor Ding presented Council Member Rivera with a plaque commemorating her
  service.

  C. PRESENTATION OF CERTIFICATES OF ELECTION AND ADMINISTRATION OF
  OATH OF OFFICE

I  i. John Wu - Member of the City Council

  Chief City Clerk Clark presented the Certificate of Election and Judge of the
  Superior Court Ed Chau administered the Oath of Office. Daphne Wu, daughter
  of Council Member Wu, made a congratulatory statement.

  Council Member Wu thanked those who supported him by voting, City
  Manager Lazzaretto, Chief City Clerk Clark, his Council colleagues, and family;
  and expressed he is looking forward to working together in the future.

  ii. Denise Menchaca - Member of the City Council

  Chief City Clerk Clark presented the Certificate of Election and State
  Unemployment Insurance Appeals Board Member and former Assemblyman
  Mike Eng administered the Oath of Office.

  Council Member Menchaca thanked her family and those who assisted in her
  re-election campaign; thanked City Manager Lazzaretto and City staff for

I  enacting Council policies and direction; commented on the importance of
  regional collaboration; and stated her priorities for her coming term of office.

  iii. Eric Chan - Member of the City Council

  Chief City Clerk Clark presented the Certificate of Election and administered the
  Oath of Office.

  Council Member Chan took his place on the dais. He thanked Police Chief Harris
  and outgoing Council Member Rivera for their service to the community;

  CITY COUNCIL REGULAR MEETING MINUTES  Page 4 of 6  December 20, 2022
   thanked his family and supporters for their help with his campaign; and stated
  he looks forward to working with his Council colleagues and staff, keeping his
  campaign promises, and serving all residents of San Gabriel.

  The following presented congratulatory certificates/recognition for the newly-
  elected Council Members:

  •  Senior Field Representative/Case Worker Maile Plan from the Office of
  Congresswoman Judy Chu

I  •
  •
  District Representative Sandra Armenta Lopez for Senator Susan Rubio
  District Director Jennifer Tang for Assemblymember Mike Fong
  •  Deputy Director of District Operations Edith Gonzalez for Supervisor Hilda
  Solis

  •  Rosemead Councilmember Sandra Armenta and Rosemead School District
  Board Member Ronald Esquivel

  •  Monterey Park Mayor Henry Lo, Vice Mayor Jose Sanchez, and Council
  Members Vinh Ngo and Yvonne Yiu

  iv. Julie Nguyen - City Clerk

  Chief City Clerk Clark presented the Certificate of Election and former El Monte
  City Clerk Jonathan Hawes administered the Oath of Office.

  City Clerk Nguyen thanked those who voted for her, her family, friends, mentor,
  boyfriend, and City Clerk Department staff; and stated she is looking forward
  to what will be accomplished in the future.

I  The following presented congratulatory certificates/recognition:

  •  Senior Field Representative/Case Worker Maile Plan from the Office of
  Congresswoman Judy Chu
  •  District Representative Sandra Armenta Lopez for Senator Susan Rubio
  •  District Director Jennifer Tang for Assemblymember Mike Fong
  •  Deputy Director of District Operations Edith Gonzalez for Supervisor Hilda
  Solis
  •  Monterey Park Mayor Henry Lo, and Council Members Vinh Ngo and
  Yvonne Yiu

  v. Kevin B. Sawkins - City Treasurer

  City Treasurer Sawkins was not present.

  D. CITY COUNCIL REORGANIZATION

I  Following discussion, a motion was made by Vice Mayor Harrington, seconded by
  Council Member Chan, to retain Tony Ding as Mayor and John Harrington as Vice
  Mayor until March 2023.

  Motion carried by a vote of 5-0 as follows:

  AYES:  CHAN, MENCHACA, WU, HARRINGTON, DING
  NOES:  NONE
  ABSTAIN:  NONE

  CITY COUNCIL REGULAR MEETING MINUTES  Page 5 of 6  December 20, 2022
   ABSENT:  NONE

  8. PUBLIC COMMENT

  Representatives from Hong Kong VIP Kitchen congratulated the newly-elected council
  members.

  Geoff Kahan congratulated newly-elected Council Member Eric Chan.

I  9. CITY MANAGER'S REPORT - None.

  10. COUNCIL COMMENTS AND CONFERENCE/MEETING REPORTS

  Council Member Menchaca wished all a Merry Christmas and Happy Holidays.

  Vice Mayor Harrington wished all a Merry Christmas and Happy New Year, and
  congratulated newly-elected and reelected Council Members.

  Council Member Wu thanked those who attended the meeting and wished all a happy
  holiday season and Merry Christmas.

  Council Member Chan thanked all and wished all happy holidays.

  Mayor Ding congratulated the newly-elected Council Members, City Clerk, and City
  Treasurer, thanked Police Chief Harris and outgoing Council Member Rivera for their
  service, and wished all a Merry Christmas.

  11. CLOSED SESSION - None.

I  12. ADJOURNMENT

  The meeting was adjourned at 8:26 P.M

  Respectfully submitted :

  Approved th is 1Jth day of January, 2023:

  ~ ~  ,
  TONY DING, Mayor

I

  CITY COUN CIL REGULAR MEETING MINUTES  Page 6 of 6  December 20, 2022
